observations.body: The signed-out employee portal shows Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and a Demo accounts section that lists emily.dawson as Employee.
The signed-out Sign in form is visible and ready for the Employee credentials.
Submitting the Employee credentials opened the authenticated dashboard for Emily Dawson.

The Employee dashboard welcomes Emily Dawson, shows pending leave requests as 0, and offers navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Notifications, Log out, Request leave, and Fill timesheet.
Request leave opened New leave request.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
The leave request form is ready; an evaluation-data Vacation request will use 2030-01-14 through 2030-01-15 and an explicit evaluation reason.
Submitting with the date fields empty displayed 'Please fill in all required fields.' and did not leave the request form.
Cancel opened My leave without submitting a leave request.

My leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days, and lists an approved Vacation request dated Aug 18–19, 2026 with a displayed duration of 3 days and manager comment 'Approved – enjoy!'.

Employee directory shows 28 employees, supports name search and department filtering, displays name, department, title, and email columns, and has three pages with Previous disabled on page 1 and Next offered.
My profile shows editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled read-only Email field, Upload photo, and Save changes. The displayed profile belongs to Emily Dawson.
Timesheet shows a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs all at 0, a total of 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week controls.
The draft timesheet is editable; an evaluation-data draft will set Monday to 1 hour for the displayed Sep 14, 2026 week.
Saving the evaluation-data draft with Monday set to 1 hour displayed 'Draft saved.' and kept the week in draft state with a 1 h total.
